text:
sara: Quick Q — I enrolled in the 401(k) portal last week but then updated my deferral mid-pay period. Does the employer match use the election effective date or what payroll actually withheld for that paycheck? Also I'm 51 — do catch-up contributions auto-enable? :thinking:

liz-peopleops: Hey @sara — match is based on what payroll withholds for the paycheck. Elections are processed by HR/payroll cutoffs; if payroll already ran for that pay period, the match reflects the earlier run.

matt-payroll: Confirming details: payroll run happens Friday evening and HR changes need to be in by Wed 12:00 PM PT to hit that run. If your change was after the cutoff it applies to the next paycheck. If you want we can check the specific run id and withholding amounts.

sara: I changed on Thursday so sounds like next paycheck. Good to know. About catch-up — do I need to opt-in somewhere?

liz-peopleops: Catch-up (Age 50+) is not auto-enabled. You need to select the "Age 50+ catch-up" option in the 401(k) portal and enter a separate catch-up deferral amount. We can request a retroactive correction only where the plan vendor allows it — rare but possible; ping us if you want us to try.

ryan-eng: If someone switches from pre-tax to Roth 401(k) mid-quarter, any gotchas on taxes or reporting? Curious about mixing during the year.

matt-payroll: You can have both pre-tax and Roth deferrals in the same year; withholding handles taxes per pay. A retroactive conversion of previously withheld pre-tax funds to Roth is a vendor operation and may create taxable income in the year of conversion — vendor / tax advisor should be consulted. No extra employer reporting beyond the usual W-2 formatting.

payroll-bot: Payroll Notice: Next payroll cutoff Wed 2026-04-07 12:00PM PT. Elections submitted after cutoff will apply to the following pay run.

sara: One more — I switched from contractor -> full-time in Feb. Does contractor pay count toward 401(k) vesting or employer match history?

liz-peopleops: Contractor time does NOT count toward Redwood's 401(k) vesting schedule. Employer match vesting starts from your full-time start date per the plan document. We can pull your FT start date and the plan's exact vesting table if you want the percent schedule.

ryan-eng: Got it — thanks for the clarity everyone :thumbsup:
